message.content:
In Blackjack, an Ace is a “flexible” card: it can be worth **either 1 point or 11 points**—whichever gives your hand the best possible total without going over 21.  

- If counting the Ace as 11 keeps your hand’s total ≤ 21, it’s treated as 11 (a “soft” hand).  
- If adding 11 would bust you, the Ace automatically counts as 1 (making the hand “hard”).  

This dual‑value rule also applies when you have multiple Aces: one Ace may count as 11 while the others count as 1, unless doing so would still keep you under 21.
